dublin_core_group.title: Miami-Dade Brownfield Sites
dublin_core_group.description: A polygon feature class of the brownfield areas within Miami-Dade County

iso_group.process_step:
#########
# GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
# and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
####

#########
# Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
####

# create directory structure and move into it
mkdir -p /data/mdc_brownfield_site/download -p /data/mdc_brownfield_site/etl
chmod -R 777 /data/mdc_brownfield_site
cd /data/mdc_brownfield_site

# set update flag based on last update and update frequency
do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1

# download if update flag is set:
if do_update == 1 then
wget --retry-connrefused --waitretry=1 --read-timeout=20 --timeout=15 -t 10 -O download/mdc_brownfield_site.json 'https://services.arcgis.com/8Pc9XBTAsYuxx9Ny/arcgis/rest/services/Brownfield_gdb/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=json' 2>&1

# load into postGIS with:
ogr2ogr -lco GEOMETRY_NAME=geom -f PostgreSQL PG:"<postgres connection>" download/mdc_brownfield_site.json -nlt multipolygon -nln mdc_brownfield_site
echo success: mdc_brownfield_site.json loaded with ogr2ogr


#########
# Step 2 - SQL script (pseudo code):
####

# remove duplicate points and make geometries valid:
UPDATE mdc_brownfield_site
  SET geom=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(geom));

# add local geometry column and reproject existing geometries into local EPSG:
ALTER TABLE mdc_brownfield_site DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS geom_local CASCADE;
SELECT AddGeometryColumn (
  'mdc_brownfield_site',
  'geom_local', 2236, 'multipolygon', 2
);
UPDATE mdc_brownfield_site
  SET geom_local=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(ST_Transform(ST_Multi(geom),2236)));
CREATE INDEX mdc_brownfield_site_geom_local_idx
  ON mdc_brownfield_site
  USING GIST (geom_local);
NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
